https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net
https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases/download/v0.0.0/u2netp.onnx

ONNX Runtime Web 1.21.0, MIT (RUNTIME-LICENSE):
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
Files copied verbatim from the pinned npm distribution at https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/onnxruntime-web@1.21.0/dist/

All inference, cropping and compositing run locally. No image data is uploaded.
Model and WASM are loaded on demand from the same Site; the service worker caches successful requests.
